groups.activity: buy the Fomorian Disruptor blueprint now

rows.label: Fomorian Disruptor Blueprint
rows.note: Gear wheel item, needed to even queue the mission

conditions: You cannot queue Fomorian Sabotage without a Disruptor already built and equipped in your Gear wheel.
The event is a manual server-side trigger with no announced schedule; recent Fomorians have come roughly every 3-4 months.

disclosures.title: when it fires
disclosures.body: DE sends an inbox message and a Fomorian Sabotage node appears next to one Relay once the community completes enough Grineer-sided Invasions. It can sit fully built for weeks before activation.

groups.meta: 1-minute build, one consumed per player per run

rows.label: Omega Isotope
rows.note: per Disruptor; event-only drop, non-Archwing missions on the attacked planet

conditions: Omega Isotopes only drop while the event is live, only on the planet being attacked, and only in non-Archwing missions.
One Disruptor is consumed per player per run, including players who never press the button — budget 4 isotopes per attempt.
bonuses: Excavation on the affected planet farms Cryotic and Isotopes at once.
Nekros Desecrate or a pilfer-augment frame stretches the isotope farm; heavies like Bombards drop multiples.

groups.meta: Rotation A, one roll per run
conditions: Break both upper-hull shield generators before entering; triggering the Disruptor before the squad is inside burns everyone's Disruptor and starts the 30-second vulnerability window early.
Get 1,400m from the core within 30 seconds of activation or you die; only one squadmate needs to escape for the mission to count.
bonuses: Shoot all 16 nodes on the core first — each destroyed node adds +25% damage taken, capping at 5x, the single biggest lever on the one-time 1,000,000-damage Catalyst milestone.
The core takes no critical hits; mod for raw damage, multishot, fire rate and reload instead — Larkspur Prime, Mausolon, Kuva Grattler and Velocitus are the named picks.
Public squads post 4-10M damage and clear the Catalyst milestone on the first run; the damage counter is a squad total, not accumulated across attempts.

disclosures.title: parts are tradeable
disclosures.body: Trade for a missing piece from a clanmate during the event; giveaway threads for spare barrels and blueprints are common while it's live.
